name_en: University Student Support Fund internal grants
name_ar: منح صندوق دعم الطالب الجامعي (المنح الداخلية)
provider: Ministry of Education and Human Resource Development (formerly MoHESR) - Directorate of Scholarships (dsamohe.gov.jo)
eligibility_text: Jordanian students enrolled in official Jordanian universities under the regular program for bachelor's and intermediate diploma levels (2025/2026 cycle, per Jordan News).
coverage_text: Full and partial grants; JUST page: Student Support Fund loans and scholarships 'cover tuition fees for a full academic year'.
documents: Apply electronically via dsamohe.gov.jo; no documents required except proof of a sibling studying at a non-Jordanian university or private community college (2025/2026)
Successful candidates complete pledge (التعهد) and guarantees (الكفالات) online

name_en: Fulbright Foreign Student Program (Jordanian Student Scholarship)
eligibility_text: Reside in Jordan; bachelor's from a MoHE-recognized university with grade 'Good' or above; excellent English; preference to Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences; MBA needs 3-5 years' experience; dual US citizens/green card holders ineligible.
coverage_text: Round-trip flight, monthly stipend, travel allowance, visa fees, medical coverage, tuition and books; up to two years of master's study in the US.
documents: Personal statement and study/research objectives essay
Copy of Jordanian passport or ID

notes: Graduate (master's) programme, not undergraduate. Academic year inferred (cycle Feb-Jun 2026 feeds 2027-28 per homepage 'awards for the academic year 2027-2028'); page itself does not state the year. Next cycle expected ~Feb 2027, not announced.

coverage_text: 12 scholarships, one per governorate, at official Jordanian universities from first semester 2026/2027, for appointment purposes (coverage details in terms document, not quoted).
